data.description: Elegant 4-7 Bedroom Villas at Damac Hills
data.long_description:
The Autograph Collection is a collection of exquisite 4-7 bedroom villas located in Damac Hills, each embodying a sincere spirit of community, sophistication and refinement. These custom-designed residences are inspired by a subtle contemporary aesthetic that emphasizes the lushness of their surroundings. The interiors of each home utilize the highest quality materials such as marble sourced from Italy, Greece and Spain, wood from around the world, and metals honed to architectural perfection.

Autograph Collection is located in DamacHills, in close proximity to the incredible amenities offered in the area. It is home to the Damac Mall, the renowned Trump International Golf Club, stables, skate park, Malibu Bay wave pool, luxury restaurants, entertainment center, a variety of sports facilities and a picturesque park area that sprawls over nearly four million square feet.

One of the features of the complex is its unique location near Dubai's major highways, allowing residents to quickly reach the city's main attractions. within 10-15 minutes are Dubai Polo & Equestrian Club, Dubai Autodrome, Miracle Garden, Global Village and IMG Worlds of Adventure.
